svg.title: Federal Funds Matchmaker for NC DHHS: Security Threat Model (Data-Flow Diagram)
svg.desc: Data-flow diagram with five trust boundaries: internet and staff devices, the Azure subscription, the AI model boundary, public third-party sources, and team workstations. Twelve STRIDE and OWASP LLM threats (T1 to T12) sit on the flows or elements they affect. Green chips are controls in place, red-outlined chips are gaps, and dashed boxes are planned controls.
svg.text: Federal Funds Matchmaker for NC DHHS: Security Threat Model
Team 14, UNC Solve-a-thon 2026 • Data-flow diagram + STRIDE + OWASP Top 10 for LLM Apps (2025) • As-built + planned • 2026-11-07 • v1.1

g.text: TB2: Azure subscription · rg-ffm-team14 · public endpoints, no VNet
of the app and the job
az acr build --no-logs · pulled at start
External entity: outside system or visitor
Arrow = request direction; responses flow back.

svg.text: Threat key (full register with status in report.html; flow numbers match architecture.svg)

text.tspan: T1 High
Spoofing (flows 9-11): no sign-in, so anyone with the URL can act as staff → planned Entra ID sign-in; today CSRF token only
T2 Med
Information disclosure: staff names, notes, labels and run logs are readable by anyone with the URL → planned Entra ID sign-in
T3 Med
Repudiation (flow 9): a decision carries only a typed name (now required) → append-only history with time, score, run id; planned signed-in user
T4 Med
Tampering (flow 12): visitors can add decisions or redraw the evaluation sample → ETag writes, history kept, confirm step
T5 Med
Information disclosure: shared keys (storage connection string, OpenAI key) → Container Apps secrets; Key Vault + MI planned
T6 Med
Elevation of privilege (flows 2-3): ACR admin user could push a changed image → planned managed identity, admin user off
T7 Med
Denial of service / tampering (flows 4-5): API outage, limits or bad data → retries, caches, 50-listing rule, raw replay, HTTPS, stale-data warning in the app
T8 Low
Denial of service: one replica, no rate limit on a public URL → input length limits; recommended: sign-in, 2+ replicas
T9 Med
LLM01 Prompt injection via third-party listing text (flow 7) → no tools, JSON validated, quotes checked, AI cannot set the score
T10 Med
LLM09 Misinformation: wrong summary, reason or ranking, over-reliance → verified quotes, score breakdown, AI error log, human decision
T11 Low
LLM02 Sensitive data in prompts (flows 6-7) → only public listing and plan text and 10 off-topic field descriptions are sent; no staff data
T12 Low
LLM10 Unbounded consumption: cost spikes → top 40 + 5 only, max 1,200 output tokens, caches; rate caps 1,000K (embed) / 500K (chat) tokens/min

g.text: MI = managed identity · ETag = version check that stops lost updates · Sec. headers = CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options DENY, nosniff · CSV guard = no spreadsheet formulas in exports
